_doc: Peer channel allowlist (#1266). Per host: undirected pairs of projects-registry.json project names whose Claude sessions may message each other over the peer@airuleset channel, each with a required topic (#1270): the one subject that pair talks about, told to both sessions at every start. A pair not listed here is refused by both ends. Accounts named by a link get the shared-dir ACL, the plugin and the launcher --channels flag on that host. The owner names the links.
